title: Fix German Translations for Context
description: German UI translations are not accurate for the architectural/AEC context. Make them all perfect. Example: "Struktur Klassisch" must be "Tragwerk Klassisch". Audit and fix all German locale display strings in CAD and related UI so terminology matches professional German AEC usage.
summary: Reworked German UI strings for professional AEC/context accuracy instead of English calques. CAD: Struktur Klassisch → Tragwerk Klassisch; Balken → Träger; Box → Quader; Primitiv → Grundkörper; Steckplatz → Platz; plus clearer action labels (Überfahren, Rohdaten, Punkt in der Welt). Puzzle native DE: Concrete Forest → Betonwald. Aligned Hover translations across plugins. Fixed schliessen/ausschliessen → schließen/ausschließen and zulaessige → zulässige in UI/compose/s. CAD German label tests pass.
